why_relevant: CEE-focused English trade outlet that republishes bancassurance and bank-group appointment news for the region, including ČSOB/KBC; a redundancy layer when primary newsrooms restructure URLs.

Czech-language aggregator that mirrors bank appointment announcements ('Novým generálním ředitelem ČSOB se stane...'); used here as the local-language counterpart to confirm and date what the international outlets aggregate.

A Czech trade portal with a dedicated appointments-and-departures rubric covering banking/insurance leadership, including Czech Banking Association leadership; the local-language structured feed this English-focused cell should pair with.

source_name: Global Payments Česká republika – oficiální web (Kontakty / O nás)
why_relevant: Largest card acquirer/processor presence in CZ (Global Payments Europe s.r.o. = former MUZO processing centre). Country-level leadership, org structure and Czech-language announcements appear here first.

source_name: GP webpay / Global Payments CZ gateway site
why_relevant: Secondary CZ property of Global Payments; product-lead and gateway org changes sometimes surface here before the main corporate site.
Worldline Czech Republic s.r.o. (Prague) is a major merchant-services/processing employer; the country subsite carries CZ jobs and local org news.

source_name: Worldline Global – media relations / press releases
why_relevant: Group-level executive appointments (e.g. merchant-services leadership hires) that cascade into CZ reporting lines are announced here.

source_name: Nexi Central Europe – corporate site (about us / company data)
why_relevant: Nexi's CEE arm covers CZ (Nexi Czech Republic s.r.o., V Celnici 1031/4, Praha 1) and does full issuing/acquiring processing plus terminal management — a core cell actor.
Group management roster and job-openings board; upstream signal for CEE/CZ country leadership and hiring waves.
Dedicated jobs subdomain of the largest Czech-origin payment gateway (GOPAY s.r.o., French-owned); direct read on headcount growth, new functions and team structure.
Where GoPay posts leadership changes and new-hire welcomes; also exposes employee-count trend.
Comgate a.s. is a major Czech PSP/terminal provider; its newsroom-style LinkedIn posts carry appointment and expansion news not always mirrored on the corporate site.
Twisto (BNPL/payments, ownership moved Zip → Param) issues Czech-language releases on management appointments and org resets — a proven org-change signal in this cell.
A dedicated Czech-language 'Personálie' (appointments) column for finance/fintech — the single highest-yield editorial feed for CZ banking & payments leadership moves.
Czech business outlet with a people/appointments category covering finance and payments executives.
Leading CZ startup/business outlet; covers ownership changes and management overhauls at payment companies (GoPay CEO succession, Twisto management reset) with named individuals.
Internet Info title covering CZ payment gateways and fintech ownership/leadership; reliable date-stamped reporting for corroboration.
CZ business daily reporting on payments-company strategy, ownership and executive changes (e.g. Twisto under Param).

source_name: Zboží a prodej – retail/payments trade title
why_relevant: Retail trade press that reprints appointment PR from payment/BNPL providers serving merchants — a niche but reliable channel for acquiring-side hires.

source_name: Obchodní rejstřík / company registry mirrors (Finmag rejstřík firem)
why_relevant: Statutory-body (jednatel / představenstvo) changes in the commercial register are a hard, dateable proxy for country-manager and CEO changes at CZ payment entities — often earlier and more reliable than PR.

source_name: EMIS company profiles – CZ payments entities (key executives)
why_relevant: Commercial database exposing key-executive rosters for Worldline CZ, Global Payments Europe/s.r.o., Diebold Nixdorf s.r.o. and peers — useful for baselining who holds which CZ role.

source_name: Profesia.cz / Profesia.sk – employer job boards (Nexi Central Europe et al.)
why_relevant: CZ/SK job board carrying Nexi Central Europe and other processor vacancies; employer-filtered pages give a per-company hiring time series for the CEE processing hubs that serve CZ.
Industry body whose member list enumerates CZ PSPs/BNPL/payment firms and whose board/working-group composition reveals who currently leads them.

source_name: E15.cz — topic tag pages (generální ředitel, banky)
why_relevant: Tag index aggregates every E15 article mentioning a CEO change, making it an efficient crawl entry point rather than scanning the whole site.

HN is the Czech reference business daily; it breaks forced exits and resignations in banking and at the ČNB that institutions do not announce (e.g. successive senior departures from ČNB around the Michl governorship).
HN's dedicated careers/management rubric — the closest thing HN has to a people-moves column, covering manager appointments, labour-market and hiring themes relevant to A5.
Long-run HN archive indexed by topic tags such as 'rezignace' — the single richest back-catalogue for reconstructing Czech banking leadership history.

Highest-reach Czech online newsroom; broke and quantified Komerční banka's multi-year headcount reduction (≈1,840 FTE cut, 7,340 -> 5,500). Strongest single source for layoffs/restructuring numbers that banks do not headline.

An explicit people-moves ledger ('Kdo je novým generálním ředitelem či finančním šéfem?') maintained as a standing tag by a Czech business outlet — exactly the de-facto personalia column this cell targets.
Companion tag ('Kdo je novým šéfem nebo členem boardu velkých firem?') focused on board-level appointments at large Czech companies including banks.
